commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Pierre Gaillouste has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' 1 - 1 The goalkeeper makes a superb save, but the ball rebounds off him out to Martin Satriano (Brest), who fires a low drive into the middle of the net.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Kamory Doumbia (Brest) tries his luck with a shot from the edge of the box, but the ball crashes against the crossbar! It would have been a superb goal.
88' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Brest.
88' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Pierre Lees-Melou (Brest) inside the box. The ball is out of play. Brest win a corner kick.
86' Romain Del Castillo goes off the pitch and Mathias Pereira Lage (Brest) comes on.
84' Carles Martinez has decided to make a change. Cesar Gelabert Pina (Toulouse) replaces Frank Magri.
82' PENALTY APPEAL after Romain Del Castillo (Brest) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
79' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Pierre Gaillouste had an easy-decision to make.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Steve Mounie as he is replaced by Bilal Brahimi (Brest).
75' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
72' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
71' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Toulouse have a corner.
70' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lilian Brassier (Brest) was quite harsh and Pierre Gaillouste didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
70' Carles Martinez decides to make a substitution. Kevin Keben will be replaced by Mikkel Desler (Toulouse).
70' That will be all from Aron Donnum who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Vincent Sierro (Toulouse).
69' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the left post.
64' Here is a change. Jeremy Le Douaron is going off and Eric Roy gives the last tactical orders to Martin Satriano (Brest).
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jonas Martin will be replaced by Hugo Magnetti (Brest).
62' Carles Martinez prepares a substitution. Moussa Diarra is replaced by Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse).
62' Thijs Dallinga (Toulouse) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Yanis Begraoui.
62' Brest have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' A cross from Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out for a corner. Brest can continue in their attacking effort.
61' The Brest players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
59' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
58' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) picks up an injury.
57' Jonas Martin (Brest) commits a rough foul. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and makes a call.
55' Denis Genreau (Toulouse) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
48' Toulouse fail to score from a corner as Marco Bizot (Brest) leaps to collect the ball.
48' The ball is cleared after Frank Magri (Toulouse) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Toulouse will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
47' Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
46' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kamory Doumbia (Brest) comes onto the pitch for Mahdi Camara.
46' The whistle blows and Pierre Gaillouste starts the second half.
45+7' The match has reached half-time.
45+7' The corner is swung in but Toulouse can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+7' Yanis Begraoui (Toulouse) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Toulouse will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+4' Yellow card. Mahdi Camara (Brest) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
43' 5:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
40' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
40' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Brest have been awarded a corner kick.
38' A quickly taken corner by Toulouse.
38' Aron Donnum (Toulouse) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
36' Romain Del Castillo (Brest) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
32' Kevin Keben (Toulouse) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
30' Kevin Keben (Toulouse) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Cristian Casseres passes the ball to the feet of Frank Magri (Toulouse), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:1.
27' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Guillaume Restes, who smothers the ball.
23' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
19' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.

19' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Frank Magri (Toulouse) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
18' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Steve Mounie (Brest) loses his marker and gets on the end of the free kick, but he is unable to control the ball properly and balloons his close-range header high over the bar.
10' Stijn Spierings (Toulouse) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
8' Kevin Keben (Toulouse) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
7' Kevin Keben (Toulouse) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
5' Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
4' Looks like Jeremy Le Douaron (Brest) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
4' Kevin Keben (Toulouse) was too forceful with his tackle and Pierre Gaillouste interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Brest will kick-off.
Pierre Gaillouste was nominated as the referee for this game.
